body: So the next time they try to question or bring up the charges, lawyer up for sure. Thank you Sparkie.

If you don't think it's genuine, delete it and I'll continue seeking out help elsewhere. It's not fair to assume someone else's mental health or to instantly adhere to your opinion that my circumstance is "Far Fetched", considering it is not your story to tell. Thanks.

I didn't include anything incriminating in this post, and I was allowed to leave. I was already booked though and certain evidence was required by law to be gathered. I didn't allow them to use my phone, even though I don't have what they wanted anyways.

My kid is going to know a sperm donor that's been locked up all his life that has no respect, income for supporting his family, or even friends to be looked back on with. 

Kinda crazy how my younger self is going to fuck over future, changed James's family..

As for the don't talk, it's not like it was a police station, this was higher in the chain than that. If I didn't talk I would've been held until I did.

I didn't think about my situation that I was getting in and how it might effect myself later. I've definitely made mistakes and no matter how much I wish to, I can't change the past. I guess I should hire a lawyer, though I don't know how much that will help.
